answer: The canyon chain is verified at intake and oasis publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 7 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 7 epochs old, anchored at a anchor checkpoint. The attacker spends 235 dollars and 13 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
